intro: Researchers have developed Paper2Agent, a framework that converts academic papers into interactive AI agents, transforming research from static documents into active systems that can accelerate discovery and application. US politicians across the political spectrum, including Bernie Sanders and Trump ally Steve Bannon, are intensifying calls for AI oversight, while OpenAI CEO Sam Altman acknowledged legitimate concerns about AI's influence while arguing the technology could benefit humanity more than any prior innovation. The EU is signaling a potential slowdown in AI development, with Ursula von der Leyen announcing plans to convene AI labs to discuss how public authorities can help pace frontier research.

whitelist.title: Reimagining research papers as interactive and reliable AI agents
whitelist.desc: Here we introduce Paper2Agent, an automated framework that converts research papers into artificial intelligence (AI) agents. Paper2Agent transforms research output from passive artefacts into active systems that accelerate use and discovery. Conventional research papers require readers to understand and adapt the paper’s code, data and methods to their work, creating barriers to dissemination and reuse.
